title: Seacrest Beach: Fool's Gold in Seacrest Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Fool's Gold in Seacrest Beach.
description_expanded:
Property includes private beach access at Water's Edge with a complimentary set of beach chairs included (March 1 - October 31). Additional beach chairs can be rented from La Dolce Vita. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

SPECTACULAR 30A GATED WATERS EDGE COMMUNITY! PRIVATE POOL! 5/5 SLEEPS 12!

Welcome to your luxurious getaway near Rosemary Beach in exclusive Waters Edge gated development, south of the famous Scenic 30A. This stunning 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom retreat is designed to accommodate up to 12 guests in ultimate comfort and style while enjoying the 260 feet of deeded Gulf access!

Nestled with surrounding lush vegetation, this two-story vacation home offers privacy and tranquility. The highlight of the outdoor area is a private lap pool, heated seasonally (additional fee) for your enjoyment. A grill area invites you to indulge in outdoor dining and relaxation amidst the natural beauty of the surroundings. Just 150 feet away is the 260 feet deeded beach access where you will find seasonal beach service of an umbrella and two beach loungers waiting for you!

Upon entering, you are greeted by a spacious main entrance that leads into a large playroom, complete with a state-of-the-art 65" TV for entertainment. Adjacent to the playroom is a bunk area, perfect for kids or additional guests, featuring two twin bunks and a 32" TV. An adjoining bathroom with a tub/shower combo ensures convenience and privacy for those staying in this area. At the opposite end of the playroom is the luxurious King master bedroom, exuding elegance with contemporary decor and ample natural light. This master suite includes a 32" TV and an ensuite bath featuring a standalone shower and a marble vanity, providing a spa-like retreat within your own private oasis.

Upstairs, you are greeted by an expansive great room that epitomizes modern elegance and relaxation. The open-concept layout seamlessly integrates multiple functional areas, perfect for entertaining and enjoying quality time with family and friends. The living area features a cozy yet sophisticated ambiance, anchored by a grand 65" SMART TV mounted for optimal viewing. Plush sofas and armchairs provide ample seating for everyone to gather comfortably around the fireplace, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, centered around a large, inviting kitchen island that doubles as a breakfast bar. The kitchen boasts high-end appliances and is meticulously stocked with everything needed for culinary adventures.

Adjacent to the kitchen is a spacious dining area with a substantial dining table, perfect for enjoying delicious meals together. Flooded with natural light from ample windows and French doors, the dining area offers scenic views of the wrap-around covered porch with the pool area below. French doors lead out to a wrap-around covered porch that spans the perimeter of the great room. This outdoor oasis is the perfect extension of the indoor living space, offering plentiful seating options for relaxing and dining al fresco. From the porch, guests enjoy picturesque views of the pool area below, enhancing the overall sense of tranquility and luxury.

Also on the second floor is Bedroom 3:This spacious bedroom is furnished with a comfortable Queen bed and includes a 32" TV for entertainment. Floor-to-ceiling blackout draperies ensure a restful night's sleep and provide privacy when desired. French doors lead out to the above-mentioned porch area, offering a select spot to enjoy morning coffee or evening relaxation.The adjoining bathroom features crisp subway tile, a single vanity with ample storage, and a luxurious standalone shower.

Similarly styled, the 4th bedroom also boasts a Queen bed and a 32" TV for added comfort and entertainment. This bedroom conveniently accesses a full hall bath adorned with floor-to-ceiling subway tile and a single vanity, ensuring guests have easy access to facilities without compromising privacy.

Lastly, the 3rd Floor Master Suite features a luxurious King bed, providing a spacious and restful sleeping area. A 32" TV is included for entertainment, while a convenient bar area equipped with an icemaker and bar sink allows for preparing refreshments like coffee or cocktails. The ensuite bathroom is elegantly appointed with a large standalone shower and a single vanity, offering a spa-like experience. French doors lead to an uncovered sun porch, providing stunning views and a tranquil outdoor space to soak in the sun or enjoy quiet moments.

In addition to this stunning home, guests will also receive complimentary court time at the Rosemary Beach Racquet Club, complimentary access to the Rosemary Beach Fitness Center, and 4 adult bikes making exploration of our beautiful area a breeze!

*PROPERTY REQUIRES A 7 NIGHT MINIMUM SATURDAY TO SATURDAY DURING SPRING BREAK & SUMMER
